ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed partners, general partner entities, and ultimate beneficial owners against the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission PEP register, the UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) consolidated list, the United Nations Security Council sanctions list, the European Union consolidated sanctions list, and the OFAC SDN/Non-SDN lists where cross-border payment rails are used; enhanced due diligence is triggered by any positive match; continuous monitoring is required for the lifecycle of the exempted limited partnership, with minimum refresh intervals of 90 days for financial portfolio tracking software operations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Gibraltar Companies Registry (GCR) — e-Registry Portal of the Civil Status and Registration Office, HM Government of Gibraltar (https://www.gibraltar.gov.gi/companies-registry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official registration language is English; corporate names must be rendered in the Latin-script alphabet; any non-Latin name is accepted only in an approved transliteration; the statutory suffix for the exempted limited partnership is 'Limited Partnership', 'L.P.', or 'E.L.P.'; misleading names implying regulated financial, banking, trust, insurance, or sovereign activity are rejected absent a regulatory license or ministerial consent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the proposed general partner or its Gibraltar legal counsel may file an administrative objection with the Registrar of Companies within 14 calendar days of the written refusal notice, attaching trademark search evidence, consents from relevant regulatory bodies, and a list of alternative statutory-compliant names. The Registrar must issue a written determination within 15 working days of the objection. Further review is available by way of an application for judicial review to the Supreme Court of Gibraltar within 28 days of the negative determination.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible on condition that the virtual address is the physical office of a licensed Gibraltar registered agent or law firm; a P.O. Box alone is not acceptable; the registered agent must accept service of process, maintain the statutory records, and be physically available during working hours; the unregulated software-only scope of financial portfolio tracking does not mandate a separate operational office in Gibraltar.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 5% estimated annual likelihood for an unregulated Fintech Software App ELP; the risk rises to approximately 20% where more than 20 registered entities share the same registered agent address, where a PEP-linked beneficial owner is present, or where third-party payment processing through Stripe or Apple IAP generates recurring revenue that requires an economic substance review.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Limited Partnerships Act 2015 (Gibraltar), ss. 1–24 and Sch. 1; Companies Act 2014 (Cap. 100), ss. 97–103 (corporate general partner); Income Tax Act 2010, ss. 5–7 (territorial taxation, offshore exemption); Limited Partnerships (Forms) Regulations 2016, Form LP-1.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Gibraltar Companies House, HM Government of Gibraltar
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form LP-1 — Application for Registration of an Exempted Limited Partnership, accompanied by the executed Limited Partnership Agreement (deed) and Form ELP-2 exemption declaration
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the general partner must make a genuine nominal capital contribution (commonly GIP 1) and limited partners' contributions are fixed in the LPA. No escrow account or paid-in capital certificate is required for a pass-through ELP; capital subscriptions are evidenced by the partnership capital ledger and audited only upon later regulated-fund conversion.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: UNANIMOUS WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF THE GENERAL PARTNER — Dated: [DD/MM/YYYY]. RESOLVED, that the general partner approves and adopts the Limited Partnership Agreement of KY ELP and the schedule of capital contributions, and subscribes to the partners' contributions as stated therein; THAT the registered office of the partnership be established at [Registered Agent Address, Gibraltar] and that Form LP-1 with the Registrar of Companies and the application for exemption with the Commissioner of Income Tax be filed; THAT [Name of Designated Officer] is appointed designated officer and registered agent, authorised to sign returns and effect the beneficial-ownership filing; FURTHER RESOLVED, that any officer may make non-substantive administrative corrections and execute ancillary documents without fresh approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies House, Business Names Registry (online name reservation counter)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IN-1 through the Gibraltar Companies House E-Recorder portal selecting an availability search for 'KY ELP L.P.' or 'KYELP Exempted Limited Partnership'; the registrar conducts similarity and misleading-name checks against the Gibraltar and UK registers. Reserve the approved name for 90 days while the formation pack is assembled.
required_dossiers: Form IN-1 name reservation application
Company Names conflict search report
Certified passport copy of the general partner
Proof of registered address of the general partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity, file up to two alternative reservations without a new fee; a third-party objection is cured by lodging a written letter of consent from the objecting undertaking.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Limited Partnership Agreement (Deed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private legal instruments drafted by Gibraltar counsel; no prior registry approval required (contractual phase)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the LPA in conformity with ss. 3–8 of the Limited Partnerships Act 2015 stating the firm name, the general partner, aggregate and class-based capital contributions, profit/loss waterfall, indemnity, management powers and dissolution rules. Execute the deed under seal by the general partner and each limited partner with witnesses, and retain the original at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Signed and witnessed Limited Partnership Agreement
Schedule of capital contributions per partner
Registered agent consent letter from the Gibraltar registered office
AML/KYC pack: passports, proof of address and corporate ownership chart (UBO)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a defect appears in the deed (e.g. lack of witness capacity or incomplete capital schedule), cure by executing an amend-and-restate deed; no adjudication fee applies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing of Form LP-1 with the Registrar of Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Gibraltar Companies House (counter or E-Recorder)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete Form LP-1 (statement of particulars) with the approved name, Gibraltar registered office, identity of the general partner, exemption declaration and the principal place of business outside Gibraltar. Submit a certified copy of the LPA, Form RO-2 registered-office consent and Form ELP-2 exemption declaration; pay the prescribed fee and obtain a stamped receipt.
required_dossiers: Form LP-1 signed by the general partner
Certified copy of the Limited Partnership Agreement
Form RO-2 registered office consent
Form ELP-2 exempt status declaration
Government fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a query notice, respond within 28 days by re-filing corrected pages via Form LP-1R without additional official fees; the original registration date is treated as operative where the remedy is filed within the notice window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue of Registration Certificate and Income-Tax Exemption Endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies (certificate of registration); Commissioner of Income Tax, Gibraltar Income Tax Office (exempt status)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the official Certificate of Registration of the Exempted Limited Partnership; file Form IT-ELP requesting exemption endorsement, demonstrating that the partnership has no Gibraltar-source income and that the general partner's residency does not alter the territorial-basis exemption.
required_dossiers: Original Certificate of Registration
Form IT-ELP application for exemption
Declaration by the general partner on non-Gibraltar-source income
Certificate of Incorporation of the corporate general partner (where corporate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commissioner queries residency, substitute a non-resident corporate general partner and file an amended Form LP-1, or request an interpretative guidance letter under the Income Tax Act 2010 for prospective certainty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Governance: Beneficial Ownership, Tax and Data-Protection Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Beneficial Ownership (BOSS); Gibraltar Income Tax Office; Gibraltar Regulatory Authority (GRA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of formation, file the BOSS beneficial-ownership return identifying the ultimate beneficial owners of the partners; complete the tax registration file IF-8 where any Gibraltar administrative presence creates obligations; and submit the GRA data-controller registration because the platform processes personal wealth data of end users.
required_dossiers: BOSS beneficial ownership return and UBO identification forms
Tax registration form IF-8
GRA data-controller registration form and fee receipt
AML/CFT KYC file on each limited partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late BOSS filing accrues daily penalties; cure by voluntary late submission with a mitigating statement, and, where the partnership genuinely has no qualifying activity, a declaration of dormant status.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment-Rails and Banking Onboarding (Stripe and Apple IAP)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GFSC-authorized Electronic Money Institutions and Stripe/Apple merchant verification desks
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a multi-currency settlement account with a GFSC-licensed EMI, presenting the certificate of good standing; complete Stripe UK merchant KYC for the Gibraltar ELP and Apple App Store Connect banking validation; connect API keys and enable Stripe Checkout and auto-renewable subscription IAP.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Registration and certificate of exempt status
LPA excerpt confirming partners' authority
UBO declaration and AML risk assessment
PCI-DSS compliance attestation (cardholder data handled via Stripe)
App Store Connect bank form and billing legal entity name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a PSP declines the fintech profile, submit the GFSC negative-clearance letter and audited projections, or apply for a standard EMI partner tier; complaints may be escalated through the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission mediation procedure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — Gibraltar Trades Licence under the Trade, Business and Professions Regulation Act is not engaged because the ELP does not carry on a scheduled trade from premises in Gibraltar; non-resident principals and foreign-source software revenue are outside the licensing schedule; any future regulated activity would trigger the Financial Services Act 2019 licensing route through the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating licence required — GFSC financial-services licence and FCA e-money passport are not triggered because the application performs analytics only, holds no client funds and renders no investment advice (banking_aml_risk_tier: Low_Risk_Standard); a voluntary negative-clearance letter may be obtained from the GFSC.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Sustainability and Climate Change (DESCC), HM Government of Gibraltar
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Not Triggered — the activity falls below the EIA Regulations 2021, Sch. 2 thresholds for manufacturing or infrastructure; no construction, warehousing, discharge or waste stream is generated by a virtual data-processing application.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No regulated point-source discharges or VOCs; cloud infrastructure must comply with ISO 14001 and EU ETS reporting only insofar as hosted by third-party data centres; minimal e-waste applies under WEEE Directive 2012/19/EU if any in-Gibraltar hardware is later disposed of.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to the virtual ELP; if a registered-office hot-desk or co-working lease is taken, the landlord must hold a fire-safety certificate under the Fire Safety at Work Regulations 2018, structural load approval and employer's liability cover; any remote Gibraltar staff remain subject to standard workplace health-and-safety notices.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Gibraltar Tax and Customs Duty Division, HM Government of Gibraltar (https://www.gibraltar.gov.gi/taxation)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity seeking to register for Gibraltar taxation obtains a Gibraltar Tax Identification Number by filing the prescribed registration application with the Commissioner of Income Tax, including the entity's constitutional documents, registered office details, particulars of partners or members, and evidence of economic substance or activity. The application is processed through the Income Tax Office under the Income Tax Act 2010 and the Taxes (Administration) Act 2010; upon approval, the entity receives a statutory GRN (Gibraltar Reference Number) used for all tax filings, VAT registration, and customs purposes. Non-resident entities with no fixed establishment or taxable supply connection are not normally required to register, but a non-resident company or partnership with Gibraltar-source income, a permanent establishment, or a place of effective management must register and disclose the relevant particulars.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Gibraltar law does not operate a check-the-box election comparable to the U.S. classification regime. An Exempted Limited Partnership registered as KY_ELP is statutorily treated as fiscally transparent unless it elects, or is deemed to have elected, to be treated as taxable under the Qualifying Partnership regime. For hybrid mismatch purposes, an ELP may elect to be treated as a separate taxable person for indirect tax and certain anti-avoidance provisions, but for income tax it remains transparent unless it carries on a trade or business through a permanent establishment in Gibraltar. Cross-border hybrid entity elections are assessed under the U.K. and Gibraltar tie-breaker rules and the OECD hybrid mismatch framework where applicable.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Gibraltar VAT and indirect purchase tax regime (integrated with EU-derived import controls, but distinct from U.K. VAT)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general VAT registration threshold because Gibraltar does not levy a local VAT on domestic transactions; however, any person importing goods into Gibraltar, or supplying services deemed to be supplied in Gibraltar for customs duty or Purchase Tax purposes, must register for the relevant transactional taxes where turnover or import volume exceeds the de minimis limits set by the Purchase Tax Ordinance and Customs Duty Ordinance. The practical threshold for purchase tax registration is nil for taxable importers, but an economic activity test applies to foreign digital service providers with no established presence.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Gibraltar does not mandate real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping for the software-as-a-service and financial portfolio tracking sector. Invoices must be issued in accordance with retained EU invoicing rules for cross-border B2B and B2C transactions, including identification of the supplier, the customer, the nature of the supply, the date, the consideration, and any applicable purchase tax or customs duty reference. No pre-clearance e-invoicing gateway exists for ISIC 6201 services; however, records of all digital exports must be retained in an electronically accessible format that permits audit by the Commissioner of Income Tax and HM Customs.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Given Gibraltar's zero-rated indirect tax system for exported services, a financial portfolio tracking software provider may claim a zero-rating or non-taxable treatment on supplies made to customers located outside Gibraltar, provided the recipient, the effective use, and the place of supply satisfy the export rules under the Gibraltar Purchase Tax and retained EU place-of-supply provisions. Offshore services concerning financial information and software-as-a-service are treated as exported if the recipient is a non-resident business or a private consumer outside Gibraltar, the supply is not effectively used or enjoyed in Gibraltar, and the supplier retains proof of the export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration or Intrastat-equivalent dispatch record for any physical media or server equipment
Commercial invoice or digital export contract containing customer identity and non-Gibraltar place of supply
Electronic evidence of delivery or cloud-service activation outside Gibraltar (e.g., server logs, IP addresses, platform activation records)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank transfer confirmation evidencing settlement in foreign currency
Written confirmation of the recipient's business status and country of establishment for B2B zero-rating claims
Annual statement of export supplies submitted to the Income Tax and Customs Duty Division
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Any false or unsupported zero-rating or export exemption claim is subject to a clawback of the unpaid Purchase Tax, plus interest from the due date, and a tax-related penalty of up to 100% of the tax evaded where the misstatement is deliberate. Misrepresentation of export status for software services may additionally trigger misuse of the Gibraltar digital services facilitation regime, with penalties for incorrect documentation of up to GBP 10,000 per transaction for a first offence and disqualification from zero-rating for a period of up to 24 months. The Commissioner may retrospectively assess up to six years for innocent errors and twelve years for deliberate concealment, and may require a bond or guarantee from the taxpayer before granting future zero-rating clearance.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of England (monetary anchor); HM Government of Gibraltar (issuer of Gibraltar pound notes and coin); Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) as banking, AML/CFT, and financial services supervisor. Gibraltar has no separate domestic central bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Gibraltar maintains no exchange-control legislation. The Gibraltar pound is fixed at parity with pound sterling and is freely convertible into GBP at 1:1. Both current-account and capital-account transactions are fully open; there are no general restrictions on inward or outward remittances, no mandatory Central Bank approvals, no profit-repatriation barriers for an Exempted Limited Partnership, and no withholding at the ELP level. Because the ELP is treated as pass-through, cash distributions to non-resident partners can be remitted freely, subject only to underlying bank AML/KYC evidence, sanctions verification, and the tax rules of the partners' countries of residence. Multi-currency balances in USD, EUR, or GBP are permissible; conversion occurs at commercial rates with a GFSC-licensed bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable in Gibraltar. There is no statutory deadline for surrendering export receipts, no minimum conversion percentage, and no requirement to route export proceeds through the Central Bank or any designated domestic account. Export proceeds and SaaS/IAP-related sale settlements may be retained in the currency received, in GIP/GBP, or converted into any acceptable clearing currency at the commercial discretion of the ELP, subject only to banking documentation and AML/CFT record-keeping.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium for ancillary transaction inflows and low-value disbursements, but Low as a principal treasury rail for the ELP. Offshore digital EMIs may be used only if the institution is appropriately authorised under a recognised e-money regime and can pass the GFSC-licensed bank's correspondent-risk checks. Legal constraints: Gibraltar payment services and electronic-money activities are prudentially supervised; an unlicensed or purely offshore EMI cannot provide the settlement finality, capital-escrow integrity, FX capacity, and clearing membership required for partner distributions or material vendor payments. Stripe and Apple IAP may settle into an EMI or bank account, but the core operating and capital accounts should remain with a GFSC-licensed commercial bank or a fully authorised UK/EU bank with a formal Gibraltar servicing arrangement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Gibraltar law does not impose a universal statutory requirement for physical attendance by partners or directors. Nonetheless, GFSC AML/CFT Rules and internal bank risk policies require substantive identification of the general partner, the authorised signatories, and all qualifying beneficial owners. Remote account opening is viable for a low-risk fintech portfolio-tracking ELP where the bank performs video-based KYC, electronic ID verification, and sanctions/PEP screening, supplemented by notarised or apostilled entity documents. A physical interview may be requested by the bank if the structure is treated as higher risk, if the register of partners contains non-transparent entities, or if the incoming capital originates from a jurisdiction with weak AML controls. Engaging a licensed Gibraltar corporate/trust services provider materially eases the on-boarding process.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore Exempted Limited Partnership with non-resident partners, pass-through tax status, and no audited financial statements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of limited partnership from the Gibraltar Registrar of Companies; current limited partnership agreement; register of partners or confidentiality affidavit identifying all 25%-plus beneficiaries; certified passports and proof of residential address for the general partner and each controller; registered office certificate; bank reference letters from the partners' existing financial institutions; signed declarations of source of funds; and a detailed business plan describing the fintech application, revenue model, and projected transaction flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large, one-time inbound capital contributions from non-UK jurisdictions or unexplained accumulation of personal wealth.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive source-of-wealth file including sale agreements, dividend vouchers, inheritance or gift instruments, employment bonus letters, tax returns, or legal counsel opinions; a source-of-funds narrative showing the exact financial trail from the partner's original account to the ELP account; independent professional adviser confirmation; bank statement chain for the remitting account; and, where necessary, tax clearance certificates or letters of good standing from the remitting jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Digital business with global consumer sign-ups and recurrent Stripe/Apple IAP income producing a payment pattern that could be misread as a virtual-asset or unregulated lending operation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed terms of service and privacy policy tailored to personal wealth analytics; App Store and Google Play merchant agreements; Stripe merchant identification and processing history; PCI DSS compliance evidence; customer-facing product documentation; monthly transaction reports showing recurring non-custodial subscription fees; a properly adopted AML/CTF risk assessment confirming that the entity does not handle third-party funds or engage in regulated deposit-taking / investment activity; and a legal opinion, where prudent, from Gibraltar counsel confirming that no financial-services licence is required for the application's functions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound partner capital must be routed by SWIFT MT103 from the partner's own bank account to the ELP's GFSC-licensed operating or capital-escrow account. The remittance instruction should include the bank-specific purpose code for 'partnership capital contribution / equity participation' (for example the bank's internal code for capital inflow, commonly CAPC or EQUI) and a free-text narrative identifying the ELP's name, the registered number, and the capital contribution transaction. The beneficiary bank will require the general partner's capital-contribution resolution, the updated partner register, source-of-funds evidence, and confirmation that no third-party intermediary is the ultimate remitter. Because Gibraltar does not apply surrender rules, incoming USD or EUR can be placed in a multi-currency account or converted to GIP/GBP through the bank's treasury desk. Sanctions screening, PEP screening, and FATF-based beneficial-ownership transparency are mandatory.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Routine vendor, cloud-cost, salary, and licensing payments must be executed over SWIFT MT103 where the counterparty is outside Gibraltar, or over SEPA/CHAPS/Faster Payments if a UK or EU account is held. For physical-goods trade, if the ELP's scope later includes hardware or white-label devices, use a commercial letter of credit through the GFSC-licensed issuing bank with MT700/MT710 advising and MT760 guarantee where required; sight drafts and document presentation must be made through the confirming bank. All outbound disbursements must follow a dual-authorisation control matrix, a standing disbursement policy, and prior tax/fATCA/CRS review for any distribution to a partner in a reportable jurisdiction.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-speculative deliverable FX forward contracts in GIP/GBP against USD or EUR, executed with a GFSC-licensed bank or correspondent treasury desk.
FX swaps (spot and forward combinations) used solely to align the timing of Stripe/IAP settlement currency receipts with operating-cost payment obligations.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies with restricted convertibility or shallow offshore markets, where the underlying operating exposure is evidenced by vendor invoices or platform settlement reports.
Plain-vanilla purchased currency options (puts and calls on GBP/USD and EUR/USD) to cap adverse translation on material contracted inflows.
Cross-currency swaps matched to specific debt, lease, or acquisition obligations, provided the instrument is non-leveraged and approved by the treasury committee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of Exempted Limited Partnership (Form ELP-AR) confirming registered office, general partner details, and the current list of limited partners
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies House Gibraltar (Registry of Limited Partnerships)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of the date of registration of the ELP, with a permitted filing grace period not exceeding 28 calendar days after the anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file within 1 month of the anniversary triggers a GIP 300 penalty; 1 to 3 months late triggers GIP 750; over 3 months late triggers GIP 1,500; continued non-compliance beyond 12 months permits the Registrar to publish a strike-off notice and administratively dissolve the ELP

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation Statement (Form BO-AR) confirming the current general partner, limited partners, and any transfer of partnership interests during the preceding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies House Gibraltar (Beneficial Ownership Register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually no later than 31 January following the end of the calendar year in which the transfer or confirmation event occurs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or update the beneficial ownership confirmation may incur an administrative fine of up to GIP 5,000, continuing daily default fines of GIP 100, and restriction notices blocking access to the beneficial ownership register until the default is remedied

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit applies to the ELP as a non-regulated, low-risk fintech portfolio-tracking vehicle holding no client funds and holding no financial-services authorization. A statutory audit becomes mandatory only if the ELP is authorized as an investment or collective investment scheme, if the general partner is itself a large Gibraltar-regulated entity, or if the partnership deed or limited partners require an audited reporting pack. Otherwise, the ELP prepares internal financial statements for partner information only and does not file accounts with the Registrar.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Gibraltar for any consolidated or investor-facing reporting; practical default for a non-regulated ELP is IFRS for SMEs or FRS 102 (UK GAAP equivalent), with management accounts converted to USD for investor reporting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The general partner must annually reconfirm that the Beneficial Ownership Register held at the registered office is accurate and up to date. Any transfer of a partnership interest in the ELP must be recorded in the Register of Limited Partners within 14 days of transfer and reflected in the next Annual Return; assignees become limited partners only after registration in the Register of Limited Partners and, where required, the general partner's written consent recorded in the Minute Book.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Register of Limited Partners and General Partner with full beneficial ownership details)
Register of Directors (maintained for the corporate general partner, including alternate directors)
Minute Book (resolutions and consent minutes of the general partner and partnership meetings)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500–3,000 per year (registered office, local corporate general partner, company secretarial and registered agent services in Gibraltar)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000–10,000 per year if an investor-requested or independent audit is required; USD 0 for an audit-exempt ELP that prepares only internal management accounts

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holidays remain after the abolition of the historic exempt-company regime. The effective rate is reduced to 0% where the ELP is a Qualifying Exempted Limited Partnership (QELP) and lacks Gibraltar-source income, or where all partners are non-resident under the pass-through model. Passive investment income of non-resident partners falls outside the Gibraltar territorial charge; no capital gains tax is imposed in Gibraltar.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Gibraltar Self-Assessment Return Form SA-ELP (limited partnership rendition of Form 2 for companies); mandatory electronic submission through the Gibraltar Revenue Authority eTax portal at etax.gra.gi.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, aligned to the financial year adopted by the ELP; the default basis period is the calendar year unless a different accounting date is approved by the Commissioner.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return must be filed within 12 months after the end of the basis period and no later than 31 December of the year following the year of assessment; if the Revenue issues a notice to file under section 23 of the Income Tax Act, the return is due within 30 days of service of the notice.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - ELP identity and tax reference
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the Exempted Limited Partnership, Gibraltar registration number, and GRAS eTax reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the registered ELP name exactly as recorded on the Gibraltar Companies Register; non-resident partners are not named as filers unless separately assessable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Start and end dates of the accounting period covered by the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident-owned ELP, use the financial year end stated in the partnership agreement; if none is stated, use 31 December.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Trading profit from the financial portfolio tracking cloud, subscription fees, and software licensing, or passive investment income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Classify Stripe and Apple-IAP subscription flows as trading receipts; attach platform settlement reports and merchant statements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable expenses: staff salaries, cloud infrastructure, legal and audit fees, corporate services provider fees, and compliance costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure expenditures are incurred through the Gibraltar bank account; non-resident partners may not deduct personal foreign expenses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Partner allocation and residence schedule
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profits allocated to each partner and the residence jurisdiction of each partner.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report zero allocated profits if 100% non-resident; append the QELP certificate, tax residence certificates, and a detailed partner schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Transfer pricing and relief claims
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of connected-party transactions and election for relief or deduction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a Local File if connected-party receipts exceed the filing threshold; otherwise confirm the de minimis position in a signed declaration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts an initial penalty of GBP 100, a continuing daily surcharge of GBP 20 per day up to GBP 3,000, and an accuracy-related penalty of up to 100% of understated tax for deliberate default. The Commissioner issues default assessments and may recover outstanding tax and penalties through the Gibraltar Supreme Court.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Gibraltar imposes no withholding tax on dividends, partnership profit distributions, or liquidation proceeds paid to residents or non-residents.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Gibraltar maintains a narrow treaty network limited to air transport agreements; the principal relevant instrument is the UK-Gibraltar Tax Co-operation and Exchange of Information Agreement, which does not provide broad withholding relief. A claim for treaty credit or exemption follows the GRAS 'Tax Residence and Treaty Benefits' procedure: (i) file the standard application in eTax, (ii) submit an original TRC certified by the foreign revenue authority, (iii) provide a legal ownership chain, and (iv) retain supporting records for six years. Where relief is denied, the ELP must settle the tax and pursue an appeal before the Income Tax Tribunal.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic withholding on royalties and interest is nil. For a Gibraltar ELP licensing software IP to foreign group companies, the 12.5% standard rate applies only to net Gibraltar-source trading income; interest paid to non-resident lenders is exempt from Gibraltar withholding. The 18% special services rate applies only to a defined list of utilities, petroleum, gambling, and associated services and does not affect fintech royalties.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: GIP 1,000,000 of aggregate connected-party revenue in the accounting period requires a full Gibraltar Local File; Master File and country-by-country reporting apply where the multinational group's consolidated revenue exceeds EUR 50,000,000. Transactions below GIP 1,000,000 require only a unilateral transfer pricing declaration within the tax return.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Gibraltar Economic Substance Guidelines require the ELP to be managed and controlled in Gibraltar, maintain a registered office and local bank account, employ adequate staff, and perform its core income-generating activities in the territory. Because the ELP is tax-transparent, the substance test applies to the partnership and, where relevant, the general partner. Provision of cloud-based portfolio tracking and payment-pairing services must be evidenced by developer contracts, server logs, board minutes, and payroll records. Failure to satisfy core income-generating activities in Gibraltar triggers automatic loss of QELP status, a 12.5% tax charge, and penalties; a pure letterbox entity is rebutted as a shell arrangement under the EU and OECD anti-harmful-tax-practice framework.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting false partner allocation schedules, understating subscription revenue in the SA-ELP return, or deliberately omitting foreign partners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty regime of the Gibraltar Income Tax Act: fines up to GBP 100,000 plus accuracy penalties of 100% of the evaded tax; aggravated offences attract summary prosecution and asset forfeiture under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2015.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The general partner and its directors can be pursued civilly for the joint tax debt on wrongful trading principles; the Gibraltar Supreme Court may impose director disqualification orders, prohibitory travel bans, and imprisonment of up to 7 years for fraudulent tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the ELP as an economic shell with no Gibraltar premises, personnel, or board functions while claiming QELP annual-fee exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of exempt status; retrospective 12.5% tax charge on profits; penalties up to 150% of the tax understated; the corporate services provider is also fined and potentially struck off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the general partner are personally liable for tax evasion debts; courts will pierce the corporate veil, freeze bank accounts, and order personal contribution orders without limitation, including seizure of foreign-held assets through anti-money laundering machinery.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing portfolio-tracking subscription payments without customer due diligence at the ELP level, operating unregistered crypto-or-fintech flows through the Gibraltar bank account, or failing to file a Suspicious Activity Report.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2015 and the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission Regulations: civil penalties up to EUR 100,000 or 10% of annual turnover, unlimited criminal fines, licence withdrawal, and confiscation orders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Senior officers are personally liable under the approved-person rules; travel restrictions, ancillary orders, extended bans on financial-services roles, and imprisonment of up to 14 years for money laundering are applicable.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Contravention and Unsupported Profit Shifting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging software subscription fees to connected non-resident customers at non-arm's length prices, failing to file a Local File above the threshold, or claiming the QELP exemption while a Gibraltar permanent establishment exercises core functions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Revenue may adjust profitability to arm's length, disallow the QELP exemption, and impose a corrective tax rate of 12.5% on the entire Gibraltar-source profit; secondary penalties of up to GBP 50,000 apply for non-disclosure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: In transfer pricing disputes, directors of the general partner face personal contribution orders for the additional tax; failure to correct the record under the Tax Administration and Practices Act founds personal liability of up to treble damages in civil proceedings.
